zh:
加州大学伯克利分校（University of California, Berkeley，简称UCB、伯克利）成立于1868年，位于美国加利福尼亚州伯克利市，是加州大学系统的旗舰校区，也是美国顶尖公立研究型大学，被誉为“公立常春藤”之首。学校下设14个学院，在校生超42000人，覆盖工程、计算机科学、环境科学、经济学、法律、新闻等全领域。
加州大学伯克利分校是硅谷科技创新的核心人才摇篮，培养了114位诺贝尔奖得主、25位普利策奖得主、14位菲尔兹奖得主、25位图灵奖得主，在计算机科学、工程、环境科学、经济学等领域长期处于世界领先地位。2026QS世界大学排名中，加州大学伯克利分校位列世界第17位。
en: University of California, Berkeley (UCB) is a public research university in Berkeley, California, United States. Founded in 1868, UCB is the flagship campus of the University of California system, and the top public university in the United States, known as the leader of 'Public Ivies'. The University comprises 14 colleges, with over 42,000 enrolled students, excelling in engineering, computer science, environmental science, economics, law, and journalism. UCB has produced 114 Nobel Prize winners, 25 Pulitzer Prize winners, 14 Fields Medalists, and 25 Turing Award winners, and is a core talent cradle for Silicon Valley. Ranked No.17 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
